news.title: LIV Golf confirms season-ending event in Michigan cancelled
news.summary: LIV Golf has confirmed its season-ending Team Championship event in Michigan will no longer go ahead, with this week's tournament in Indianapolis to be a stroke-play event that concludes the season.
